0p300_analysis.explanation: The controller has no explicit height-holding objective. The 22mm CoM drop over 50s is slow contact compliance/settling. The robot survived 5000 steps without falling.

0p380_analysis.note: The 57Nm value in Experiment 0 summary appears to be from a diagnostic/telemetry field, not actual per-joint applied torque
0p380_analysis.actual_per_joint_torques: Much smaller values observed in detailed telemetry (similar to 0.300m case)

rationale.0p300: No fix required - height drop is expected behavior for a posture controller without height-holding. The robot survived 5000 steps.
rationale.0p380: The 57Nm hip-roll value is likely diagnostic (distribution-related), not actual applied torque. Actual per-joint torques are in normal range.

monitor: Continue monitoring 0.300m CoM behavior in future experiments
